rationale.text: The page's only frame is an iframe with a title attribute. The test asks whether each frame has a title attribute, and the methodology validates it when every frame has one. The custom check answers no_fault (step 1), so the finding is needs_review, not_enabled, at fail_only. Its link is resolving, so at full the derivation would give passed; the entry is measured at fail_only.

citations.quote: Chaque cadre (balise `<iframe>` ou `<frame>`) a-t-il un attribut `title`
Pour chaque cadre, vérifier qu’il possède un attribut
Si c’est le cas pour chaque cadre, **le test est validé**.
